title: Staying Current in Tech
summary: This note details the owner's deliberate efforts to stay current in tech, which involves engaging with the community, analyzing real incidents, building personal products, and learning from experts. The owner stays current by attending conferences, digging into incidents like the CrowdStrike outage, building tools with AI, and talking with industry practitioners.

Dig deeper into security and patching after the CrowdStrike outage
